headline: RBI Governor meets NBFC, HFC heads; stresses customer focus, CKYCR use and cyber security
summary_points: RBI Governor met MDs & CEOs of select NBFCs, Government NBFCs, HFCs and MFIs in Mumbai on 23 November 2026.
Sa-Dhan, MFIN and FIDC representatives, four Deputy Governors and the NHB MD & CEO also attended.
NBFCs urged to ensure responsible credit growth, quality service, grievance redressal and fair recovery practices.
Entities encouraged to use CKYCR for onboarding and keep customer records in the registry updated.
Governor urged stronger cybersecurity and a risk-based approach to cyber and IT risks, with board and senior management oversight.
who_is_affected: NBFCs, Housing Finance Companies and Microfinance Institutions, along with their boards, senior management and compliance teams.
action_required: Review customer service, grievance redressal, recovery practices, CKYCR record updation and cyber/IT risk governance, and brief the board accordingly.

social.linkedin:
RBI Governor meets NBFC and HFC leadership

On 23 November 2026, the Governor of the Reserve Bank of India met MDs & CEOs of select NBFCs, Government NBFCs, HFCs and Microfinance Institutions in Mumbai. Sa-Dhan, MFIN and FIDC representatives also took part.

Key messages:
- Responsible and sustainable credit growth, with customers put first
- Focus on quality service, effective grievance redressal and fair recovery practices
- Use of the Central KYC Records Registry (CKYCR) for onboarding, and keeping records up to date
- Stronger cybersecurity and a comprehensive, risk-based approach to cyber and IT risks, with board and senior management oversight

This is not a new circular, but it signals RBI's supervisory priorities for the NBFC sector. Compliance and risk teams may want to factor these themes into their reviews.

Please verify details with the official RBI press release (2026-2027/1554) before acting.
